name: incline-bench-cable-row-rope-extension.html
instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to around a 45-degree angle and position the bench with the highest end facing the cable pulley machine.
2. Attach a rope extension to the lower pulley and set the weight you want to use on the stack.
3. Grab the rope and position yourself with your chest on the bench, feet on the floor, and hands gripping the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing inwards). This is the starting position.
4. Slowly pull the rope in towards your lower chest as far as possible.
5. Pause, and then slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for desired reps.
